tutorial_android_export: In Export, select Export Selected Range (MP4). Wait for the completion message, then open the downloaded video.
tutorial_android_load: Tap Open Clip Folder and select the entire TeslaCam folder or a clip folder. Then tap a clip in the imported list to preview it.
tutorial_ios_export: In Export, select Export Selected Range (MP4). Keep the app open until it finishes, then find the download in the Files app.
tutorial_ios_load: Tap Open Clip Folder and select the entire TeslaCam folder or a clip folder. Then tap a clip in the imported list to preview it.
tutorial_mobile_range: Move the timeline to your start position and tap In Point. Move to the end position and tap Out Point to save just that range.
tutorial_pc_export: Select Export Selected Range (MP4) to save your video. Keep this tab or app open until it finishes.
tutorial_pc_load: Choose Open TeslaCam Folder and select the entire TeslaCam folder or a clip subfolder. Then choose a clip from the imported list to preview it.
tutorial_pc_range: Move the timeline to your start position and select In Point. Move to the end position and select Out Point to define the export range.
tutorial_warning: When a USB 2.0 iPhone, such as a standard model or iPhone Air, reads external storage over OTG, importing many files can take a long time. In this case, use Select Files to pick only the clips for the time you need. You can also copy those clips to your iPhone before editing.
